# dothings.lol

> AI-curated weekly events guide for South East Queensland — Brisbane, Gold Coast, and Sunshine Coast.

dothings.lol aggregates events from dozens of local sources and uses multiple AI models (Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT) to filter and rank them, highlighting workshops, meetups, live music, community events, art classes, outdoor activities, talks, markets, and unique experiences worth leaving the house for.

## City pages

- [Brisbane events](https://www.dothings.lol/brisbane)
- [Gold Coast events](https://www.dothings.lol/gold-coast)
- [Sunshine Coast events](https://www.dothings.lol/sunshine-coast)

## About

- Events are collected weekly and re-ranked using AI scoring
- Each city page lists curated events with title, date, location, cost, category, and description
- Calendar subscriptions available as .ics files for each city
